Loss report: gitlab -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (spec) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.inputs (Woodpecker has no typed pipeline inputs)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy/step/script step.shell (Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.env: copied into the environment of every step (a step variable of the same name wins)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
